summary.text: Brad Roae is a Republican state representative from northwestern Pennsylvania who was first elected to House District 6 in November 2006 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the Republican side of the House State Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Roae graduated from Maplewood High School in 1985 and earned a Bachelor of Science degree in business administration from Gannon University in 1990.
From August 1992 until November 2006 he was a commercial underwriter with Erie Insurance, where he earned professional designations and taught as an instructor at the insurance institute.
He served 23 years as a volunteer firefighter and 18 years as a volunteer emergency medical technician with the East Mead Volunteer Fire Department.
Roae was first elected to the state House in the November 7, 2006, general election.
He previously chaired the House Commerce and Consumer Affairs committees, and in 2019 he was appointed to the Board of Governors of the Pennsylvania State System of Higher Education.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Michael Walker as his opponent in the general election.
